statements: UniProt P08174 sequence and construct boundaries plus AlphaFold confidence values survive only as source-bound inputs; they do not establish protease behavior.
Recognition-pattern counts, region tallies, and pLDDT distributions are deterministic inventories under the retired rules and have no validated biological interpretation.
A matched full-ectodomain-versus-SCR1–4 comparison remains a Research Conjecture; direct evidence for a truncation advantage is absent.
